name: twrses-art
description: 美術 Art 的顏色引擎（color.js 純函式：光的混色、顏料混色的示意模型、色彩空間換算、色差；lights.js 牆面上的光斑與影子；match2d.js／zoom2d.js 不需要 WebGL 的小互動）與各課 3D 的原始碼。產物寫到 assets/js/art-*.js，npm run build 重新打包。

scripts.build: esbuild src/art-lights.js src/art-wheel.js src/art-ball.js src/art-line.js src/art-hall.js src/art-depth.js src/art-frame.js src/art-face.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=eof --outdir=../../assets/js
scripts.test: node test/color.test.mjs && node test/lights.test.mjs && node test/wheel.test.mjs && node test/shade.test.mjs && node test/stroke.test.mjs && node test/persp.test.mjs && node test/depth.test.mjs && node test/frame.test.mjs && node test/face.test.mjs
